development_population.outcome_status: All KIFMS V7 outcomes are open and may be used only for development
development_population.review_deletion: Forbidden; every outer fold holds out exactly one of all fourteen reviews

mandatory_base.representation: word TF-IDF ngram_range=(1,2), min_df=1, max_df=0.95, sublinear_tf=True, lowercase=True
mandatory_base.active_loop: The V7 seed, batch, refit, complete-order and stable-tie rules are unchanged
mandatory_base.equality_requirement: V8 base metrics and order hashes must equal V7 R1_L1 exactly in all fourteen reviews

residual_score_definition.learner: The same u4 LinearSVC and 9.8 balancer are fitted on the residual representation; only representation changes
residual_score_definition.normalization: At each active batch, base and residual pool scores are separately transformed to population z scores with ddof=0; a zero-variance score becomes all zeros
residual_score_definition.fallback: If no configuration passes the other-thirteen-review support rule, execute the unchanged raw-score u4 base; equality to the separately executed base order is mandatory

residual_families.mechanism: Suppress singleton vocabulary while retaining word unigrams and bigrams
residual_families.representation: word TF-IDF ngram_range=(1,2), min_df=2, max_features=50000, sublinear_tf=True, lowercase=True

residual_families.mechanism: Double the title contribution relative to the abstract before applying the u4 word representation
residual_families.representation: word TF-IDF over title + title + abstract, ngram_range=(1,2), min_df=1, max_df=0.95, sublinear_tf=True, lowercase=True

residual_families.mechanism: Add morphology and spelling-sensitive character evidence without changing the u4 learner
residual_families.representation: char_wb TF-IDF ngram_range=(3,5), min_df=2, max_features=30000, sublinear_tf=True, lowercase=True

nested_leave_one_review_out.selection_data: For outer held-out review h, use configuration outcomes from exactly the other thirteen reviews
nested_leave_one_review_out.selection: Among supported configurations choose greatest mean delta CRE20, then greatest mean delta WSS95, then greatest worst-review delta R10, then lower alpha, then declared family order
nested_leave_one_review_out.outer_estimate: Apply the selected configuration or exact fallback only to h; aggregate one held-out result per review

reported_estimands: cross-fitted unweighted mean delta CRE20 versus exact u4
cross-fitted unweighted mean delta R@10 versus exact u4
cross-fitted unweighted mean delta WSS95 versus exact u4
strictly positive held-out-review counts for CRE20 and R@10
exact-u4 fallback frequency and selected-configuration counts
forbidden_claims: KIFMS confirmation, validation, or independent custody
source-general, domain-general, workflow-general, or application-exact superiority
relaxation or reinterpretation of any V7 threshold
post-outcome review deletion or endpoint substitution
source-disjoint performance before a separately frozen execution
next_discriminator: Freeze one deterministic donor-envelopment controller from this development rule and compare it with unchanged u4 plus a residual ablation on a lawful source family disjoint from SWIFT, SYNERGY V5, and KIFMS V7.
